governing_thought: Philosophy is divided by the kind of claim at issue: what there is, how we know and think, how we reason and mean, and what is valuable.
dimension: the kind of claim at issue
rank_note: Ordered from claims about reality, to claims about knowing it, to claims about reasoning, to claims about value.

pillars.title: Being
pillars.statement: Claims about being ask what exists and what ultimately is, as in metaphysics and the philosophy of religion.

pillars.title: Knowledge and mind
pillars.statement: Claims about knowledge and mind ask how we know and what minds are, as in epistemology, philosophy of mind and consciousness, and the philosophy of the sciences.

pillars.title: Reason and meaning
pillars.statement: Claims about reason and meaning ask what makes inference valid and how language means, as in logic and the philosophy of language.

pillars.title: Value
pillars.statement: Claims about value ask what is good, right, beautiful and just, as in ethics, aesthetics and political and social philosophy.

method_line.title: Method line
method_line.covers: philosophical traditions, the history of philosophy and of the humanities
